_comment: Daily API spend tracker config for the /quota skill (issue #458). daily_cap_usd is the soft daily budget that quota-budget.sh checks today's spend and end-of-day projection against. pricing is keyed by a substring matched against the assistant message model id (longest match wins; 'default' is the fallback). All prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens. quota-usage-hook.sh reads this file to cost each response; quota-budget.sh reads daily_cap_usd. Override the path in tests with QUOTA_CONFIG.
